title: First NAND decision tree
statement: Define a decision tree on two sign-valued inputs that first queries the first coordinate. If its value is $1$, the tree returns $-1$; otherwise it queries the second coordinate and returns $1$ exactly when that value is $-1$, returning $-1$ otherwise.
